sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A HIGH-LATITUDE OMEGA BLOCK WILL PERSIST...FEATURING AN AMPLIFIED RIDGE OVER THE CANADIAN PRAIRIE PROVINCES...BRACKETED BY TROUGHS OVER THE NERN PACIFIC/WRN CANADA/NWRN U.S. AND ERN CANADA/NERN CONUS. WITHIN THIS BROAD-SCALE PATTERN...A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER THE PACIFIC NW WILL PROGRESS ENEWD THROUGH THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION WITH THIS SYSTEM PRECEDED BY A WEAKER IMPULSE MOVING FROM WRN/CNTRL WY INTO ERN MT BY AFTERNOON. FARTHER E...A SERIES OF LOW-AMPLITUDE PERTURBATIONS WILL TRANSLATE FROM THE UPPER GREAT LAKES...UPPER MS VALLEY...AND MID MO VALLEY SEWD THROUGH THE OH VALLEY AND LOWER GREAT LAKES TO THE MID ATLANTIC COAST. AT THE SURFACE...A LEE CYCLONE OVER CNTRL MT WILL DEVELOP SLOWLY EWD INTO THE WRN DAKOTAS BY 02/12Z IN TANDEM WITH A PACIFIC FRONT ADVANCING THROUGH THE NRN HIGH PLAINS. THIS LOW PRESSURE WILL LINK WITH A WARM FRONT LIFTING NWD THROUGH THE NRN PLAINS AND UPPER MIDWEST. THE ERN EXTENSION OF THIS BOUNDARY WILL ASSUME MORE COLD-FRONTAL PROPERTIES AS IT SETTLES SWD THROUGH THE UPPER OH VALLEY AND MID ATLANTIC STATES. A LEE TROUGH WILL STRENGTHEN TODAY FROM INTERSECTION WITH COLD FRONT SWD ACROSS THE PIEDMONT OF THE CAROLINAS AND GA.

sections.title: CAROLINAS/GA
sections.text: 12Z MHX/CHS/JAX SOUNDINGS SHOW AN IMPRESSIVE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY LOWEST 100-MB MEAN-MIXING RATIOS OF 16-20 G/KG BENEATH A PRONOUNCED EML /I.E. 700-500-MB LAPSE RATES OF 9.0-9.5 C PER KM/...YIELDING MUCAPE OF 4000-6500 J/KG. LATEST CONVECTION-ALLOWING AND MESOSCALE MODEL GUIDANCE IS RATHER CONSISTENT IN SUGGESTING THAT LEE TROUGH AND DEVELOPING SEA BREEZE BOUNDARY WILL FOCUS SCATTERED TSTM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON WITHIN A KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT FEATURING EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR VALUES OF 25-35 KT. GIVEN THE EXTREME INSTABILITY FORECAST...SUFFICIENT SHEAR WILL EXIST FOR INTENSE UPDRAFTS/SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL. MERGING STORM-SCALE COLD POOLS MAY SUPPORT UPSCALE GROWTH OF STORMS INTO CLUSTERS WITH AN INCREASED RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS THROUGH THIS EVENING.

sections.title: AL/MS
sections.text: 12Z REGIONAL SOUNDINGS INDICATE AN OVERLAP OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER AND ENHANCED MIDLEVEL FLOW ON SRN PERIPHERY OF UPPER HIGH WHICH ARE EXPECTED TO FOSTER SCATTERED STRONG-SEVERE STORMS THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING. DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD...ESPECIALLY IF STORMS CAN COALESCE INTO CLUSTERS AND ORGANIZE A COLD POOL.

sections.title: MN/IA THROUGH OH VALLEY INTO CNTRL APPALACHIANS
sections.text: A COUPLE OF ELEVATED TSTM COMPLEXES ARE ONGOING AS OF 12Z INVOF WARM/STATIONARY FRONT...ONE OVER NERN MO/SERN IA/W-CNTRL IL AND THE OTHER ACROSS SERN IND/SWRN OH/NERN KY. FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH WEAK MIDLEVEL IMPULSES EMBEDDED WITHIN PREVAILING WNWLY FLOW REGIME APPEARS TO BE PRIMARY MECHANISM FORCING THESE STORMS. WHILE IT REMAINS UNCLEAR WHETHER EITHER OF THESE COMPLEXES WILL PERSIST...MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS THE POTENTIAL FOR MULTIPLE TSTM COMPLEXES TO DEVELOP ALONG THE SYNOPTIC FRONT THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING. REGION WILL REMAIN ALONG SRN FRINGE OF STRONGER MIDLEVEL FLOW AND RESULTANT VERTICAL SHEAR. HOWEVER...THE DEVELOPMENT OF A MODERATE-STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS SHOULD COMPENSATE WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR ORGANIZED STORM MODES INCLUDING BOWING STRUCTURES WITH A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH MIDLEVEL IMPULSES MENTIONED IN SYNOPSIS ARE EXPECTED TO GIVE RISE TO AN INCREASE IN TSTMS THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING FROM PACIFIC FRONT STRETCHING THROUGH CNTRL/SWRN MT EWD TO VICINITY OF MIGRATORY SURFACE LOW AND ATTENDANT WARM FRONT OVER ERN MT INTO THE WRN DAKOTAS. THOUGH BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE WILL REMAIN LIMITED...THE PRESENCE OF STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL CONTRIBUTE TO MLCAPE OF 500-1500 J/KG OVER CNTRL MT TO 1500-2500 J/KG NEAR SURFACE LOW AND WARM FRONT IN SERN MT AND NWRN SD. WHEN COUPLED WITH A VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILE AND 40-50 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...SETUP WILL FAVOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF SUPERCELLS AS THE INITIAL STORM MODE WITH A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. STORMS MAY GROW UPSCALE INTO AN MCS TONIGHT WITH A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME HAIL SPREADING EWD INTO ND. ..MEAD/HURLBUT.. 07/01/2012

sections.title: MID ATLANTIC TO SRN NEW ENGLAND THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: STRONG SURFACE HEATING IS UNDERWAY FROM ERN VA TO SRN NEW ENGLAND...WHERE BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS RANGE FROM 65-70 F. RECENT VISIBLE IMAGERY SHOWS CUMULUS DEVELOPMENT IN SE NY ALONG A SURFACE TROUGH...AND THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED AROUND MIDDAY AS THIS AREA IS BRUSHED BY A SUBTLE EMBEDDED SPEED MAX ROTATING EWD FROM THE LOWER GREAT LAKES. STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...MLCAPE NEAR 1500 J/KG...AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR NEAR 35 KT WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTERS /AND PERHAPS SOME SUPERCELL STRUCTURES/ WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL THIS AFTERNOON. FARTHER S INTO THE MID ATLANTIC...THE FOCUS FOR STORM DEVELOPMENT IS NOT PARTICULARLY CLEAR. HOWEVER...THE MODIFIED 12Z IAD SOUNDING SUPPORTS AFTERNOON MLCAPE OF AT LEAST 2500 J/KG WITH LITTLE CONVECTIVE INHIBITION AS SURFACE TEMPERATURES WARM INTO THE LOW-MID 90S. THERE IS A WEAK UPSTREAM TROUGH/REMNANT MCV CROSSING THE APPALACHIANS AS OF LATE MORNING...AND AT LEAST ISOLATED STORM DEVELOPMENT APPEARS PROBABLE WITH CONTINUED DAYTIME HEATING. THE MODERATE INSTABILITY AND MIDLEVEL FLOW NEAR 40 KT APPEARS SUPPORTIVE OF BOTH ORGANIZED CLUSTERS AND MARGINAL SUPERCELLS...CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING

sections.title: SRN VA/NC THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: A SMALL MCS OVER SW VA HAS PRODUCED DAMAGING WINDS AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL DURING THE PAST COUPLE OF HOURS. GIVEN THE STRONG SURFACE HEATING DOWNSTREAM ACROSS VA/NC...MODIFIED 12Z SOUNDINGS SUGGEST THAT SOME UPSCALE GROWTH AND MORE EXTENSIVE SURFACE-BASED STORM DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON. MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE UNUSUALLY STEEP OVER THIS AREA...WHICH WILL SUPPORT STRONG-EXTREME INSTABILITY THIS AFTERNOON AS SURFACE TEMPERATURES WARM TO NEAR 100 F...ESPECIALLY ALONG AND E OF A WEAK SURFACE TROUGH ACROSS THE CENTRAL CAROLINAS. GIVEN THE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT...AS WELL AS THE SRN FRINGE OF 30-40 KT MIDLEVEL WNWLY FLOW...THERE WILL BE THE POTENTIAL FOR AN ORGANIZED DAMAGING WIND CORRIDOR ACROSS SRN VA AND NC THIS AFTERNOON WITH THE ONGOING MCS. ...SC/GA/AL AREA THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. STORM DEVELOPMENT WILL LIKELY RELY ON INTENSE SURFACE HEATING AND WEAK LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ALONG THE SURFACE TROUGH FROM CENTRAL AL ACROSS GA INTO SC...POTENTIALLY AIDED BY WEAK INLAND PENETRATION BY THE ATLANTIC COAST SEA BREEZE IN SC/GA. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE WEAK...BUT THE STRONG-EXTREME BUOYANCY AND STEEP LOW-MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL STILL SUPPORT BOTH STRONG UPDRAFTS AND HAIL FOR

sections.title: OH VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: OUTFLOW/GRAVITY/FRONT MERGERS HAVE AIDED IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF A NEW CLUSTER OF STORMS IMMEDIATELY S-SW OF CHICAGO. THIS AREA IS ON THE SRN FRINGE OF THE STRONGER WLYS ALOFT...WHILE THE DOWNSTREAM AIR MASS CONTINUES TO DESTABILIZE INTO INDIANA/OH. THERE WILL BE SOME POTENTIAL FOR UPSCALE GROWTH/MCS FORMATION...WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS/LARGE HAIL TROUGH THE AFTERNOON.

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON/TONIGHT
sections.text: NO SIGNIFICANT CHANGES...SEE PREVIOUS OUTLOOK DISCUSSION. ..THOMPSON/SMITH.. 07/01/2012

sections.title: CNTRL/ERN CAROLINAS INTO ERN GA
sections.text: EXPANDED THE SIGNIFICANT WIND PROBS ACROSS THE ENTIRE AREA. 18Z SOUNDINGS SHOW EXCESSIVE INSTABILITY WITH LI VALUES OF -15 TO -18 AND HIGH PRECIPITABLE WATER APPROACHING 2.00 INCHES. STORMS SHOULD CONTINUE TO GEL FROM CNTRL/ERN NC ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE OUTFLOW...AS WELL AS INTO CNTRL SC AND ERN GA WITHIN THE SFC TROUGH. DAMAGING WET MICROBURSTS ARE LIKELY...AND ONE OR MORE SMALL CLUSTERS OF STORMS MAY EVENTUALLY FORM AND PROPAGATE SWD PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS. ALTHOUGH SHEAR IS WEAK...LARGE HAIL UP TO AROUND 2.00 INCHES DIAMETER WILL BE POSSIBLE DUE TO EXTREME UPDRAFT VELOCITIES. A FEW LARGER STONES COULD OCCUR WITH ISOLATED SUPERCELLS MOVING S OR SWWD OFF THE HODOGRAPH

sections.title: IND/OH/WV
sections.text: A CLUSTER OF STORMS CONTINUES TO ORGANIZE ACROSS NRN IND...AND SHOULD CONTINUE EWD...THEN SEWD ACROSS OH AND WV WHERE STRONG INSTABILITY EXISTS. A CORRIDOR OF SEVERE WINDS MAY MATERIALIZE WITH THIS CLUSTER...THUS HAVE EXTENDED THE 30% WIND PROBABILITIES SEWD.

sections.title: NERN KS/NWRN MO
sections.text: EXTENDED THUNDER AND 5% WIND PROBS SWD INTO THE REGION AS TOP SOUNDING SHOWS A RELATIVELY MOIST/COOL PROFILE WITH LITTLE CAPPING. GPS WATER VAPOR OBSERVATIONS SHOW A POCKET OF HIGHER VALUES AS WELL...AND A STORM OR TWO COULD FORM OVER NERN KS WITH WEAK SPEED CONVERGENCE AT THE SURFACE AND AN EXPANDING CU FIELD. ..JEWELL.. 07/01/2012 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT SUN JUL 01 2012/

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON/TONIGHT
sections.text: NO SIGNIFICANT CHANGES...SEE PREVIOUS OUTLOOK DISCUSSION.

sections.title: THE SOUTHEAST
sections.text: WHILE STORMS HAVE MOVED OFF THE ERN NC COAST...OTHER CONVECTION CONTINUES FROM THE NC/SC BORDER SWD ACROSS SC AND INTO GA. IN THIS REGION...DEGREE OF INSTABILITY SHOULD SUPPORT A CONTINUATION OF STRONG/SEVERE STORMS -- AND ASSOCIATED THREATS FOR WIND/HAIL -- FOR AT LEAST THE NEXT FEW HOURS. WILL ALSO EXPAND HIGHER SEVERE PROBABILITY SWD ACROSS SRN GA -- WHERE SWD PROPAGATION OF A WELL-ORGANIZED BAND OF STORMS IS EVIDENT...INTO A VERY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT.

sections.title: MID AND UPPER OH VALLEY TO THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION
sections.text: A BAND OF STRONG/LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS CONTINUES FROM SERN INDIANA/NRN KY NEWD INTO OH...WITH THE OH PORTION OF THIS BAND EXHIBITING SEWD PROPAGATION. WITH AN UNSTABLE/LARGELY UNCONTAMINATED AIRMASS RESIDING ACROSS SRN PA/WV/MD/VA...POTENTIAL APPEARS TO EXIST THAT THE STORMS MAY CONTINUE ACROSS THE MOUNTAINS INTO/ACROSS VA AND VICINITY...ACCOMPANIED BY THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME HAIL. THUS...HAVE EXPANDED/INCREASED SEVERE PROBABILITY ACROSS THIS REGION TO HIGHLIGHT THIS POTENTIAL.

sections.title: MT INTO THE NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED FROM PARTS OF ID INTO MT...AHEAD OF A LEAD SHORT-WAVE IMPULSE EMBEDDED WITHIN MODERATELY STRONG MID-LEVEL SWLYS. WITH MODERATE INSTABILITY ACROSS MOST OF MT...EXPECT THREAT FOR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL TO CONTINUE THROUGH THE EVENING ACROSS WRN AND CENTRAL MT...AND POSSIBLY WELL INTO THE OVERNIGHT PERIOD IN ERN MT AND INTO WRN ND AS STORMS SPREAD EWD WITH TIME. ISOLATED STORMS HAVE ALSO DEVELOPED ALONG THE ENTIRE BREADTH OF THE HIGH PLAINS...WHERE AMPLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT AND LOW-LEVEL SELY FLOW IS AIDING SOME SEWD MOTION OF THE CONVECTION TOWARD LOWER TERRAIN. HOWEVER...WITH BACKGROUND RIDGING ALOFT AND THE LOSS OF DIURNAL HEATING...EXPECT STORMS TO BEGIN DIMINISHING IN INTENSITY LATER THIS EVENING...WITH SEVERE POTENTIAL CONFINED TO THE HIGH PLAINS REGION. ..GOSS.. 07/02/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM CLUSTER OVER FAR ERN KY SHOULD GROW UPSCALE AS INTENSE SURFACE HEATING OCCURS DOWNSTREAM WITHIN A POTENTIALLY STRONG TO EXTREMELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS E OF THE APPALACHIANS. A SEVERE TSTM WATCH WILL BE PROPOSED SHORTLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTM CLUSTER HAS INTENSIFIED OVER ERN KY. DOWNSTREAM SURFACE TEMPERATURES HAVE ALREADY WARMED INTO THE 80S AND WILL REACH THE 90S LATER THIS MORNING RESULTING IN STRONG BUOYANCY AMIDST RATHER STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES OF 8-8.5 C/KM AT 700-500 MB PER 12Z RNK/GSO RAOBS. WITH A BELT OF MODERATELY STRONG WLY FLOW NOTED IN THE RNK/ILN RAOBS...UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A DAMAGING WIND-PRODUCING MCS WITH EMBEDDED SEVERE HAIL APPEARS PROBABLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE WIND/HAIL THREAT PERSISTS IN THE NEAR-TERM ACROSS FAR SWRN VA. POTENTIAL STILL EXISTS FOR EVENTUAL UPSCALE GROWTH AS DESTABILIZATION CONTINUES AND ACTIVITY MOST LIKELY PROPAGATES E/SEWD. DOWNSTREAM WW MAY BECOME NECESSARY IF THIS OCCURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTM CLUSTER OVER FAR SWRN VA HAS GENERALLY SHRUNK IN SPATIAL EXTENT DURING THE PAST HOUR WHILE CROSSING HIGHER TERRAIN. STILL...FULL INSOLATION IS OCCURRING DOWNSTREAM WITH CONVECTIVE TEMPERATURES HAVING BEEN REACHED IN MODIFIED 12Z RNK RAOB WITH VERY STEEP LOW/MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. RECENT 59 KT WIND GUST MEASURED AT KMKJ CONFIRMS THAT SEVERE DAMAGING WINDS SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY THREAT IN THIS ENVIRONMENT. CONVECTION-ALLOWING AND OPERATIONAL MODEL GUIDANCE APPEAR POOR IN REPRESENTING THIS ONGOING CLUSTER. THUS UNCERTAINTY IS RATHER LARGE IN HOW EXACTLY THE CLUSTER WILL EVOLVE AS STORM-SCALE/COLD POOL PROCESSES DOMINATE. ADDITIONAL CELLS MAY FORM ALONG CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW TO THE SW AND ALSO EWD ALONG THE VA/NC BORDER WHERE ALTOCUMULUS HAS PERSISTED IN THE WAKE OF SAT NIGHT CONVECTION. ..GRAMS.. 07/01/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED TSTMS SHOULD FORM THIS AFTERNOON WITH ATTENDANT THREATS FOR SEVERE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND. AREA WILL BE UPGRADED TO SLIGHT RISK WITH THE 1630Z D1 OUTLOOK AND WATCH ISSUANCE WILL BE CONSIDERED IN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CU HAS INITIATED ALONG THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF SRN NY INTO CNTRL PA ALONG A WEAK LOW-LEVEL BAROCLINIC ZONE BENEATH THE INFLUENCE OF SUBTLE UPPER-LEVEL IMPULSES CROSSING THE LOWER GREAT LAKES. 12Z OPERATIONAL GUIDANCE ALONG WITH RECENT HRRR RUNS HAVE A PRONOUNCED SIGNAL FOR CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT...LEADING TO INCREASING CONFIDENCE THAT POTENTIALLY SCATTERED TSTMS SHOULD FORM CENTERED TOWARDS THE HUDSON VALLEY. SURFACE TEMPERATURES HAVE WARMED INTO THE UPPER 80S AND LOWER 90S WITH DEW POINTS HOLDING IN THE MIDDLE TO UPPER 60S...WHICH IS YIELDING MODERATE BUOYANCY /INCREASING WITH SRN EXTENT/ PER MODIFIED 12Z IAD/OKX RAOBS. MODERATELY STRONG NEARLY UNIDIRECTIONAL WLY FLOW WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR ORGANIZING UPDRAFTS WITH THREATS OF SEVERE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR ISOLD LARGE HAIL AND SEVERE MICROBURSTS WILL INCREASE AS STORM COVERAGE INCREASES THIS AFTERNOON. SHORT TERM TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE/RADAR MOSAIC OVER THE PAST FEW HOURS HAS SHOWN A COLLAPSING TSTM COMPLEX INVOF THE IA/IL/MO BORDER. A GROWING AREA OF TSTMS OVER NERN IL MAY BE THE RESULT OF AN ARCING GRAVITY WAVE INTERACTING WITH A FRONTAL ZONE DRAPED ACROSS THE REGION. 12Z DVN/ILX RAOBS FEATURED STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES AROUND 8 DEG C/KM. AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER CONTINUES TO HEAT AND DESTABILIZES FURTHER...UPWARDS OF 3000-4000 J/KG MLCAPE PER NAM FORECAST SOUNDINGS WITHIN A BELT OF MODEST WLY-NWLY FLOW...ON THE FRINGE OF A SRN MICH MID LEVEL SPEED MAX...WILL ACT TO SUPPORT ORGANIZED SEVERE MULTICELLS CAPABLE OF ISOLD LARGE HAIL/SEVERE WIND GUSTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE TO THE S/W OF WW 442 WILL BE LIKELY IN THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CU IS GROWING OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN IN WRN NC AND FARTHER SE INTO PARTS OF THE SC PIEDMONT. THIS DEVELOPMENT IS OCCURRING WITHIN A STRONGLY TO EXTREMELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS WITH HOT SURFACE TEMPERATURES IN THE MIDDLE 90S TO NEAR 105. ALTHOUGH MID-LEVEL FLOW WEAKENS WITH SRN EXTENT OWING TO ANTICYCLONE CENTERED OVER CNTRL GA...THE VERY STEEP LOW/MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL SUPPORT HYBRID PULSE/MULTICELL STORMS CAPABLE OF BOTH LARGE HAIL AND SEVERE MICROBURSTS. WITH TIME...CELL MERGERS MAY YIELD A S/SEWD-PROPAGATING MCS DRIVEN BY INTENSE CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW. ..GRAMS.. 07/01/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: HIGH CAPE/LOW SHEAR SHOULD YIELD A PULSE-TYPE ENVIRONMENT WITH SPORADIC LOCALIZED MICROBURSTS AND BRIEF/MARGINAL HAIL AS ISOLATED TO SCATTERED TSTMS FORM ACROSS PARTS OF MS TO GA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: HOT TEMPERATURES IN THE UPPER 90S TO NEAR 105 AND PW VALUES AROUND 1.5 INCHES ARE YIELDING VERY LARGE BUOYANCY WITHIN A PLUME OF STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. ALTHOUGH DEEP-LAYER WIND PROFILES ARE WEAK AND VARIABLE...INDICATIVE OF A PULSE-TYPE/DISORGANIZED ENVIRONMENT...THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY WILL CERTAINLY SUPPORT A THREAT FOR MICROBURSTS AND PERHAPS BRIEF SEVERE HAIL. PREDOMINATELY SLY MID-LEVEL FLOW MAY HELP STEER CONVECTION NWD TOWARDS THE TN VALLEY...BUT OUTFLOWS WILL LIKELY EMANATE IN ALL DIRECTIONS THIS AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PORTIONS OF WW 442 MAY NEED TO BE EXTENDED N/EWD IN SERN VA. COVERAGE/INTENSITY OF THE SEVERE THREAT IN NC SHOULD INCREASE DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: PERSISTENT SMALL TSTM CLUSTER NOW APPROACHING THE RDU/I-85 CORRIDOR IN N-CNTRL NC/S-CNTRL VA SHOULD CONTINUE ON A GENERAL E/SEWD PROGRESSION...WHILE CONVECTION HAS BECOME SCATTERED FARTHER S IN THE PIEDMONT TO COASTAL PLAIN. WITH ACTIVITY APPROACHING/DEVELOPING WITHIN THE AXIS OF EXTREME INSTABILITY AMIDST MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AROUND 8.5 TO 9 C/KM IN THE 18Z MHX/CHS RAOBS...UPSCALE GROWTH IS LIKELY IMMINENT. THIS SHOULD YIELD INCREASING COVERAGE/INTENSITY OF SEVERE WIND WITH EMBEDDED SEVERE HAIL CORES. ..GRAMS.. 07/01/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLD-WIDELY SCTD TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON. ISOLD MICROBURSTS WILL POTENTIALLY BE CAPABLE OF POCKETS OF STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS A SMALL AGITATED CU FIELD WITH A FEW TSTMS DEVELOPING IN THE PAST HOUR. STRONG SURFACE HEATING HAS RESULTED IN TEMPS WARMING INTO THE LOWER 100S WITH 30-40 DEG F TEMP/DEWPOINT SPREADS AND DRY ADIABATIC LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES. DESPITE WEAK TROPOSPHERIC FLOW...APPRECIABLE PW /AOA 1.5 INCH/ AND DCAPE IN EXCESS OF 1500 J/KG WILL SUPPORT A HYBRID MICROBURST ENVIRONMENT AND A RISK FOR POCKETS OF STRONG TO LOWER-END SEVERE WIND GUSTS /I.E. WIND DAMAGE POTENTIAL/.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL/WIND THREAT PERSISTS AND IS DEVELOPING N/EWD OF WW 444 IN MA/RI. ALTHOUGH IT DOES NOT APPEAR SPATIALLY TO WARRANT A NEW WW...IT COULD BE LOCALLY EXTENDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: GREATEST CLUSTERING OF TSTMS HAS OCCURRED ACROSS SRN NEW ENGLAND TO THE LOWER HUDSON VALLEY. A FEW OF THESE HAVE EXHIBITED SUPERCELL CHARACTER AND WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A THREAT FOR ISOLATED SEVERE WIND/HAIL. SURFACE TEMPERATURES IN THE UPPER 80S TO LOWER 90S IN MOST OF MA OUTSIDE OF CAPE COD SUGGEST ACTIVITY MAY REMAIN SEVERE AS IT SHIFTS JUST N/E OF WW 444. FARTHER SW...TSTMS HAVE FAILED TO INITIATE S OF NERN PA THUS FAR ALONG THE SURFACE TROUGH. BUT WITH THE CU FIELD PERSISTING...CONTINUED HEATING WITH MODERATELY STRONG INSTABILITY MAY BE SUFFICIENT FOR ADDITIONAL TSTMS BY EARLY EVENING. ..GRAMS.. 07/01/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE TSTM CLUSTER OVER N-CNTRL AND NRN IND IS EXPECTED TO MOVE INTO WRN OH AND THEN INTO CNTRL-SRN OH AND POSE A STRONG-SEVERE WIND GUST RISK AND ASSOCIATED WIND DAMAGE THREAT. A NEW SEVERE TSTM WATCH WILL NEED TO BE CONSIDERED OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS DOWNSTREAM OF THE EXISTING WATCH FOR AREAS OVER CNTRL AND S-CNTRL OH AND POSSIBLY WV.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE SHOWS A WNW-ESE BAND OF ACCAS AND AN AGITATED CU FIELD OVER SWRN AND W-CNTRL OH TO THE E OF THE STRONG TO SEVERE STORM COMPLEX OVER NRN IND. CLOUD-BEARING UNIDIRECTIONAL WNWLY FLOW WILL ACT TO AID IN MOVING THE EXISTING STORMS ESE DOWN A VERY UNSTABLE CORRIDOR FROM E-CNTRL IND INTO SERN OH. OBSERVED STORM AND COLD POOL MOTION AROUND 280/35 KTS AND LINEAR EXTRAPOLATION SUGGEST THE LEADING EDGE OF THE STORM COMPLEX WOULD EXIT THE EXISTING SEVERE WATCH BY 23Z. WITH SURFACE-H5 LAPSE RATE LAYER EXCEEDING 8 DEG C/KM ON AREA FORECAST SOUNDINGS...THE MAINTENANCE OF THE EXISTING COMPLEX AND WIND DAMAGE POTENTIAL WILL LIKELY CONTINUE WELL INTO OH...AS 25-50 KT MID-UPPER LEVEL FLOW SUPPORTS STORM LONGEVITY/SEVERITY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LARGE HAIL/ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND PERSISTS...WITH POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS INCREASING IN SERN NC AND CNTRL/ERN SC DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MOST INTENSE MULTICELL CLUSTERS HAVE REMAINED INVOF THE BORDER OF WW/S 442/445 IN SRN NC TO N-CNTRL SC AND LARGE HAIL UP TO 2 INCHES HAS BEEN REPORTED WITH THIS ACTIVITY. MERGING OF CELLS APPEARS TO BE LEADING TO UPSCALE GROWTH SIMILAR TO THE EVOLUTION OF AN ACCELERATING LINE IN N-CNTRL/NERN NC. WITH 8.5-9.5 C/KM 700-500 MB LAPSE RATES SAMPLED IN 18Z CHS/MHX RAOBS...THE EXTREME INSTABILITY SHOULD LEND ITSELF TO SUBSTANTIAL COLD POOL FORMATION AND ACCELERATE S/SEWD PROPAGATION OF ONGOING ACTIVITY. THIS EVOLUTION MAY YIELD BOWING SEGMENTS AND INCREASING COVERAGE/INTENSITY OF SEVERE WIND GUSTS PRIMARILY TOWARD THE NC/SC COASTAL PLAIN. WITH SWRN EXTENT...DEEP-LAYER FLOW WEAKENS SUBSTANTIALLY TO THE MID-LEVEL ANTICYCLONE CENTERED OVER CNTRL GA /PER AREA VWP DATA/. THIS SUGGESTS COLD POOL EVOLUTION INTO GA WILL BE MORE DISORGANIZED AND DEPENDENT ON STORM-SCALE PROCESSES TO YIELD MORE THAN SPORADIC MICROBURSTS. ..GRAMS.. 07/01/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLD LARGE HAIL/STRONG TO SEVERE WIND THREAT SHOULD PERSIST THIS AFTERNOON INTO THE EARLY EVENING OVER SWRN MN AND MAY POSSIBLY DEVELOP FARTHER S OVER PORTIONS OF NRN IA -- CONTINGENT UPON ROBUST STORM DEVELOPMENT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SURFACE MESOANALYSIS PLACES A SLOWLY RETREATING FRONTAL ZONE ACROSS NRN IA EXTENDING WNWWD INTO SWRN MN AND ERN SD. A FEW STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED OVER THE PAST FEW HOURS NEAR THE FRONT IN SWRN MN WITHIN A CU FIELD. A REMNANT MCV IS LOCATED NEAR SUX BUT UNCERTAINTY REMAINS REGARDING ITS ROLE IN PROMOTING ISOLD STORM INITIATION AND SUBSEQUENT ROBUST UPDRAFT DEVELOPMENT IN LOCALES FARTHER S ACROSS NWRN AND N-CNTRL IA. IN THE MEANTIME...STRONG POTENTIAL INSTABILITY /3000 J/KG MLCAPE PER OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS/ INVOF THE FRONT WILL ACT TO AT LEAST SUPPORT STRONG TO SEVERE MULTICELLS CAPABLE OF A LARGE HAIL/WIND DAMAGE THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AT LEAST ISOLATED TSTMS APPEAR TO BE FORMING OVER SERN MT WITHIN A VERY DEEPLY-MIXED THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT. AS THIS ACTIVITY DEVELOPS TOWARDS A MODESTLY BUOYANT AIR MASS AND WITH DEEP-LAYER SHEAR/LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE EXPECTED TO STRENGTHEN...A RISK FOR ISOLATED SEVERE WIND/HAIL SHOULD DEVELOP BY EARLY EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: HIGH-BASED TCU/SMALL CBS HAVE FORMED WITHIN AN AIR MASS CHARACTERIZED BY SURFACE DEW POINT DEPRESSIONS AROUND 60-70 DEG F IN SERN MT. DOWNSTREAM OF THIS...AN AXIS OF 40S-50S SURFACE DEW POINTS EXISTS WHICH PER MODIFIED 19Z GGW RAOB WILL SUPPORT MODEST BUOYANCY. SUBSTANTIAL VEERING OF THE WIND PROFILE WITH HEIGHT MAY YIELD LP-TYPE SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WITH RISKS OF ISOLATED SEVERE WIND/HAIL. AS THE LLJ INTENSIFIES WITH APPROACH OF A WEAK MID-LEVEL IMPULSE OVER THE NRN ROCKIES AND CONVERGENCE EWD-PROGRESSING COLD FRONT INCREASES...COVERAGE/INTENITY OF TSTMS MAY BECOME SUFFICIENT TO WARRANT A WW ISSUANCE BY EARLY EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISSUANCE OF A SVR TSTM WATCH IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MLCAPE VALUES OF 1500-2500 J/KG AMIDST MODERATE DEEP SHEAR OWING TO 45-50 KT OF WSWLY FLOW WITHIN THE 5-6-KM-AGL LAYER PER CLEVELAND VWP DATA WILL SUPPORT A SVR THREAT. CLUSTERS OF INTENSE STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED ACROSS FAR NERN IND AND ADJACENT SRN LOWER MI ALONG A WIND SHIFT AXIS...AND THE THREAT FOR SVR STORMS WILL TRACK INTO NRN OH DURING THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. SOME INHIBITION MAY EXIST OVER NRN FEW TIERS OF OHIO COUNTIES ADJACENT TO THE LAKESHORE OF LAKE ERIE WHERE STABLE WAVE CLOUDS BILLOW STRUCTURES ARE PRESENT PER VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY. HOWEVER...SHOULD COLD POOL DEVELOPMENT OCCUR AMIDST THE HIGHLY CONDITIONALLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS...A MORE WIDESPREAD SVR THREAT MAY ENSUE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN INTENSE...BUT COMPACT STORM COMPLEX...WILL TRACK ESEWD/SEWD INTO/ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL OHIO DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS...PERHAPS IMPACTING SWRN PARTS OF THE COLUMBUS AREA AROUND 700 PM EDT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WITH 3000-4000 J/KG OF MLCAPE AND 30-35 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR IN PLACE AHEAD OF AN INTENSE CONVECTIVE CLUSTER NOW ENTERING CLARK COUNTY /STORM MOTION OF 35-40 KT/...ALONG WITH DCAPE VALUES IN EXCESS OF 1400 J/KG...A HIGH-END SVR WIND THREAT WILL EXIST ALONG THE TRACK OF THIS STORM. WITH OVER 75 KT OF FLOW SAMPLED AROUND 2200 FT AGL IN ASSOCIATION WITH A REAR INFLOW CHANNEL ATTENDANT TO THE STORM...SFC WINDS OVER 75 MPH WILL BE POSSIBLE. AND...9-KM CAPPI DATA WOULD SUGGEST DEEP CONVECTIVE CORES WITH SVR HAIL...POTENTIALLY WIND-DRIVEN...ALSO LIKELY. GIVEN ITS COMPACT NATURE AND CURRENT TRACK...THE COMPLEX MAY PASS JUST SOUTHWEST OF THE COLUMBUS METROPOLITAN AREA...BUT POTENTIALLY CLIP SWRN SUBURBS INCLUDING GROVE CITY AROUND 700 PM EDT. CURRENT TRENDS SUGGEST THAT NRN SUBURBS FROM DUBLIN TOWARD WORTHINGTON...WESTERVILLE...AND NEW ALBANY MAY AVOID IMPACTS FROM SVR STORMS IN THE SHORT TERM. ADDITIONAL INTENSE STORMS DEVELOPING WELL SOUTH OF THE COLUMBUS AREA MAY POSE A SVR THREAT INTO FAYETTE/PICKAWAY/ROSS COUNTIES DURING THE NEXT HOUR. ..COHEN.. 07/01/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR SVR STORMS CONTINUES ACROSS WW 444...WITH ANY REMAINING SVR THREAT TRANSITIONING TOWARD/OFF THE COAST. REMAINING VALID PARTS OF THE WW SHOULD BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE BY THE SCHEDULED EXPIRATION TIME OF 00Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE SVR THREAT IS DECREASING IN SPATIAL EXTENT...AS DRIER AIR IN THE WAKE OF A PRE-FRONTAL WIND-SHIFT AXIS MAKES ADDITIONAL PROGRESS TOWARD THE COAST. WITH MLCAPE VALUES OF 500-1750 J/KG IN ADVANCE OF THE WIND-SHIFT AXIS AMIDST MID-LEVEL WLY FLOW AROUND 35 KT PER UPTON NY VWP DATA -- OFFERING MODEST DEEP SHEAR -- ISOLATED TO SCATTERED ORGANIZED/MULTICELL STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO TRANSITION TO AND OFF THE COAST FROM LONG ISLAND TOWARD SERN MA DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR SO. AS NOCTURNAL STABILIZATION INCREASES...AND DRIER AIR CONTINUES TO FILTER INTO THE REGION...THE SVR THREAT IS EXPECTED TO HAVE SUBSIDED BY THE 00Z SCHEDULED EXPIRATION TIME. ..COHEN.. 07/01/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTIVE COVERAGE IS INCREASING OVER MTNS OF SWRN MT AND ADJACENT PORTIONS E-CENTRAL ID...INITIALLY WELL W OF WW 449...IN ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY FAVORABLE MOISTURE AND DEEP-LAYER SHEAR. DAMAGING GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL EACH ARE ANTICIPATED WITH MOST INTENSE/PERSISTENT CELLS AS REGIME SPREADS/EXPANDS NEWD ACROSS PORTIONS WRN/CENTRAL MT THRU REMAINDER AFTERNOON INTO EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY INDICATES SHORTWAVE TROUGH ALOFT...MOVING NEWD ACROSS CENTRAL ID TOWARD WRN MT. IN ADVANCE OF THIS FEATURE...VWP...MODIFIED RAOBS AND MODEL SOUNDINGS SHOW FAVORABLE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR OVER THIS REGION...JUXTAPOSING WITH INCREASING LARGE-SCALE ASCENT/DESTABILIZATION ALOFT. BROAD AREA OF 50-60 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDE IS EVIDENT OVER WRN TO CENTRAL MT...IN SUPPORT OF ORGANIZED SVR POTENTIAL INCLUDING A FEW SUPERCELLS. SFC MESOANALYSIS SHOWED CYCLONES OVER ERN AB AND ALSO NERN MT NEAR GGW...CONNECTED BY OCCLUDED FRONT. COLD FRONT IS DRAWN FROM MT LOW ARCHING SWD/SWWD TO ANOTHER LOW NEAR GEY. BEHIND THIS FRONT...MOISTURE REMAINS AT LEAST MRGLLY FAVORABLE WITH WWD EXTENT AND ELEVATION...INCLUDING ANOMALOUSLY HIGH 50S/60S DEW POINTS IN COOLER AIR OVER NRN ID/NWRN MT...W OF GREATEST SVR POTENTIAL. DIABATIC SFC HEATING AND VERTICAL MIXING HAS RENDERED LOWER DEW POINT VALUES OVER WRN/CENTRAL MT AND E-CENTRAL ID...BUT MAINTAINED 500-1500 MLCAPE AND MINIMAL MLCINH IN SUPPORT OF TSTM FORMATION/MAINTENANCE. IN THIS ENVIRONMENT...PRIND TSTMS ALREADY MOVING NEWD ACROSS SWRN MT WILL BE MAINTAINED AND POSE SVR RISK...AS WILL ANY ADDITIONAL/SUSTAINED DEVELOPMENT OVER DISCUSSION AREA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SVR THREAT WILL REMAIN HIGH ACROSS N-CNTRL OHIO IN THE SHORT-TERM.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CLUSTERS OF MULTICELLS...SOME EXHIBITING TRANSIENT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES...WILL CONTINUE TO TRACK ESEWD/SEWD ACROSS N-CNTRL OH DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ONE PARTICULARLY INTENSE CELL IS TRACKING ACROSS THE SANDUSKY AREA...AND SHOULD IMPACT HURON COUNTY DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR SO. GIVEN THEIR PRESENT TRACK...STORM CLUSTERS SHOULD APPROACH THE MEDINA-MANSFIELD AREAS WITHIN THE 2330-0030Z TIME-FRAME. AND...WITH 1000-2000 J/KG AMIDST 40 KT OF 0-6-KM BULK SHEAR PER CLEVELAND VWP DATA...THE SVR THREAT WILL REMAIN HIGH WITH THIS ACTIVITY. ..COHEN.. 07/01/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SVR THREAT ACROSS REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF WW 442 WILL CONTINUE TO DIMINISH DURING THE NEXT HOUR...AND ANY REMAINING VALID PARTS OF THE WW WILL BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE BY 0000Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WIDESPREAD CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING AND NOCTURNAL STABILIZATION SHOULD ALLOW THE SVR THREAT TO DIMINISH DURING THE NEXT HOUR. THUS...THE SHORT-TERM SVR THREAT WILL SUBSIDE...AND ANY REMAINING VALID PARTS OF THE WW WILL BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE BY 0000Z. ..COHEN.. 07/01/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SVR TSTM WATCH MAY BE NEEDED DOWNSTREAM OF THE CNTRL/N-CNTRL OHIO CONVECTIVE LINE. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION CONTINUES TO ELONGATE ALONG THE N-S-ORIENTED LEADING EDGE OF A COLD POOL MATERIALIZING ACROSS THE WRN HALF OF OHIO OWING TO BOTH NRN AND CNTRL OHIO CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS. MODERATE MID-LEVEL FLOW PER CLEVELAND VWP DATA OFFERING 35-50 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR IS PRESENT. COLD POOL/SHEAR INTERACTIONS MAY BE ADEQUATE TO CONTINUE TO SUPPORT UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH AS ACTIVITY APPROACHES NERN OH AND EVENTUALLY WRN PA. AS SUCH...SOME POTENTIAL FOR A RELATIVELY MORE SUBSTANTIAL DMGG WIND THREAT MAY ENSUE. HOWEVER...RELATIVELY MORE LIMITED INSTABILITY NORTH OF A DIFFUSE STATIONARY FRONT MAY HINDER MORE ROBUST CONVECTIVE GROWTH DESPITE ENHANCEMENT OFFERED BY COLD POOL/SHEAR BALANCE. AS SUCH...WW ISSUANCE DOWNSTREAM IS NOT CERTAIN...BUT IS POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR SVR WINDS/HAIL WILL PERSIST ACROSS WW 445 THROUGH 0200Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LOOSELY ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE LINE FROM 40 NE CHARLESTON SC TO 30 NNE VIDALIA GA WILL CONTINUE FORWARD-PROPAGATING TOWARD THE COAST AMIDST MLCAPE VALUES AOA 4000 J/KG AND DCAPE VALUES IN EXCESS OF 1300 J/KG. DESPITE THE GENERALLY WEAK TROPOSPHERIC FLOW...THE EXTREME NATURE OF THE INSTABILITY WILL SUPPORT SVR HAIL AND SVR WIND GUSTS ACROSS SRN SC AND ADJACENT PARTS OF GA DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. ADDITIONAL CLUSTERS OF STORMS THAT DEVELOPED OVER THE SRN APPALACHIANS THAT ARE CROSSING PARTS OF THE NC/SC PIEDMONT WILL ALSO CONTINUE TO POSE A SVR THREAT AMIDST STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES BEFORE INTERACTING WITH THE CONVECTIVELY OVERTURNED AIR FARTHER SOUTH IN THE WAKE OF THE AFOREMENTIONED ACTIVITY. ..COHEN.. 07/01/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CLUSTERS AND SHORT LINES OF TSTMS MAY PRODUCE GUSTS NEAR SVR LIMITS...CAPABLE OF MINOR WIND DAMAGE...THROUGH ABOUT 03Z. ATTM POTENTIAL APPEARS TOO MRGL/ISOLATED FOR WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERAL SUCH AREAS OF CONVECTION ALREADY ARE EVIDENT OVER WRN PORTIONS OF DISCUSSION AREA...BOTH ALONG AND W OF SINUOUS DRYLINE ANALYZED NEAR IEN...SNY...AKO...LHX...CAO...TCC. THOSE PORTIONS OF DRYLINE NOT SUBSTANTIALLY MODULATED BY TSTM OUTFLOW MAY RETREAT WWD THROUGH REMAINDER EVENING. HOWEVER...OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES AND THEIR INTERSECTIONS WILL PLAY GREATEST ROLE IN ANY ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT VIA FORCED AND ISENTROPIC ASCENT PROCESSES ON LOCAL TO MESOBETA SCALES. ELONGATED PLUME OF FAVORABLE BUOYANT AND WEAKLY CAPPED BOUNDARY-LAYER AIR WILL PERSIST NEAR AND E OF DRYLINE. MOISTURE INCREASES WITH EWD EXTENT...BUT SO DOES CINH. PRECONVECTIVE TEMPS GENERALLY MID 90S F AND SLOWLY DIMINISHING...ALONG WITH DEW POINTS UPPER 40S TO MID 50S F...APPLIED TO MODEL FCST SOUNDINGS...YIELD 1000-1500 J/KG MLCAPE MOST AREAS. REGION IS UNDER STRONGLY DIFLUENT MID-UPPER FLOW...BUT NOT PARTICULARLY STG...RESULTING IN 30-35 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES OVER MOST OF THIS CORRIDOR. DEEP/WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYERS WILL AUGMENT GUST POTENTIAL LOCALLY FROM THESE TSTMS...UNTIL NOCTURNAL/DIABATIC COOLING OF BOUNDARY LAYER YIELDS SUFFICIENTLY DEEP NEAR-SFC PROFILE OF STATIC STABILITY TO MINIMIZE GUST POTENTIAL WITH REMAINING CONVECTION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR SVR WINDS WILL CROSS ERN/SRN OH INTO CNTRL/WRN WV AND NERN KY DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THE GREATEST COVERAGE OF DMGG WINDS IS EXPECTED ACROSS SERN OH INTO WRN/CNTRL WV AS STORMS CROSS THE OHIO RIVER SHORTLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION CONTINUES TO INTENSIFY ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF A STRONG COLD POOL FEATURING 2-HRLY PRESSURE RISES OF AROUND 2-3.5 MB WITHIN THE WILMINGTON-COLUMBUS-MANSFIELD-CLEVELAND CORRIDOR. AN ORGANIZING LEADING-LINE/TRAILING-STRATIFORM QUASILINEAR CONVECTIVE SYSTEM /QLCS/ APPEARS TO BE DEVELOPING...EXTENDING FROM NEAR CLEVELAND TO ZANESVILLE ARCING SWWD TOWARD PORTSMOUTH. THE SEGMENT OF THIS QLCS SOUTH OF INTERSTATE 70 WILL POSE THE GREATEST THREAT FOR WIDESPREAD DMGG WIND GUSTS AS IT CROSSES THE OHIO RIVER...APPROACHING THE CHARLESTON AREA WITHIN THE 0200-0300Z TIME FRAME. AN ABUNDANCE OF SVR WIND REPORTS...INCLUDED MEASURED SVR GUSTS...HAVE OCCURRED ACROSS CNTRL OH WITH THIS LINE OF STORMS. AND...AS IT ENCOUNTERS A ZONE OF 2000-3500 J/KG MLCAPE DOWNSTREAM AMIDST 30-40 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...FORWARD PROPAGATION WILL CONTINUE. FARTHER NORTH...INSTABILITY IS SOMEWHAT LOWER NORTH OF A DIFFUSE STATIONARY FRONT...WHICH MAY MITIGATE THE COVERAGE OF SVR WIND GUSTS TO SOME DEGREE. REGARDLESS...COLD POOL/SHEAR INTERACTIONS WILL SUPPORT CONTINUED SVR POTENTIAL. WW/S 446 AND 447 HAVE BEEN EXPANDED EWD UPON COORDINATION WITH AFFECTED WEATHER FORECAST OFFICES. COUNTIES MAY BE CLEARED FROM THE WW/S FOLLOWING PASSAGE OF THE CONVECTIVE LINE. ..COHEN.. 07/02/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SVR TSTM WATCH MAY BE NEEDED FOR AREAS TO THE E OF WW/S 446/447/448 DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION AT THE LEADING EDGE OF AN INTENSIFYING COLD POOL ACROSS CNTRL OHIO CONTINUES TO MODESTLY ACCELERATE ESEWD/SEWD...WITH STORM MOTIONS NOW REACHING 40-45 KT. AND WITH 25-35 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...FORWARD PROPAGATION INTO A ZONE OF STRONG INSTABILITY FEATURING MLCAPE VALUES OF 2000-3500 J/KG MAY TAKE THE SVR THREAT EAST OF ONGOING OH/WV/KY/IND WATCHES IN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS FOR DOWNSTREAM WW ISSUANCE...AS LACK OF RECENT ANTECEDENT OVERTURNING MAY SUPPORT A MORE WIDESPREAD SVR THREAT INTO THE EVENING/OVERNIGHT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MOST OF BOTH WWS SHOULD BE MAINTAINED...THOUGH NERN WY PORTIONS MAY BE CLEARED SOON. SFC MESOANALYSIS SHOWS LOW NEAR GGW...COLD FRONT ARCHING SWD/SSWWD TO SECONDARY LOW OVER NRN BIGHORN BASIN...AND VERY SLOW-MOVING WARM FRONTAL ZONE...QUASISTATIONARY IN SOME PORTIONS...FROM MT LOW ESEWD ACROSS EXTREME S-CENTRAL ND. POST COLD-FRONTAL SVR POTENTIAL -- MOVING INTO WRN PORTIONS WW 449 LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING -- WILL BE COVERED IN SEPARATE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WRN DAKOTAS REGION REMAINS BENEATH AND JUST W OF EWD MOVING UPPER RIDGE...HOWEVER SHORTWAVE TROUGH LIFTING NEWD FROM NRN ROCKIES SHOULD MAINTAIN AT LEAST MRGL DEEP-LAYER SHEAR THROUGH GRADIENT-ENHANCEMENT EFFECTS. REGIONAL VWP AND PLANAR MODEL DATA INDICATE GEN DECREASE IN DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WITH SWD EXTENT FROM SERN MT...I.E. EFFECTIVE MAGNITUDES NEAR 50 KT OVER ERN MT AND 35-40 NEAR SD/NEB BORDER. THIS GEN TENDENCY SHOULD CONTINUE THROUGH EVENING...BUT AMIDST DECIDEDLY DIFLUENT MID-UPPER STREAMLINES...AND OBJECTIVELY ANALYZED FIELD OF 300-MB DIVERGENCE OVER NWRN SD. SFC MESOANALYSIS INDICATES DRYLINE BULGE WWD AROUND NRN PART OF BLACK HILLS...CORRESPONDING TO CHANNEL OF MOIST/SELY FLOW WITH WHICH CONVECTION MOVING OUT OF NERN WY SHOULD INTERACT DURING NEXT 1-2 HOURS. CONVECTION ALONG AND W OF DRYLINE AREA-WIDE WILL BE CAPABLE OF SVR GUSTS PENETRATING DEEP/WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER...WHILE ACTIVITY N OF WARM FRONT MAY PRODUCE SVR HAIL AND ISOLATED SVR GUSTS. BOTH GGW AND UNR RAOBS SAMPLED SUCH CONDITIONS...WITH POTENTIAL FOR MLCINH TO INCREASE SUBSTANTIALLY GIVEN A FEW DEG C BOUNDARY-LAYER COOLING IN A FEW HOURS...NEAR SUNSET. APPARENTLY PYROCONVECTIVELY GENERATED SVR TSTM OVER SERN MT S OF BHK SHOULD INTERACT WITH WARM FRONT OVER SWRN ND...MOVING INTO ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY GREATER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE BUT ALSO STRONGER MLCINH. AS SUCH...TEMPORARY INTENSIFICATION IS POSSIBLE OVER PORTIONS BOWMAN/SLOPE COUNTIES...AFTER WHICH STRENGTHENING/COLD-POOL AIDED FORCED ASCENT MAY BE NEEDED TO SUSTAIN ACTIVITY. VIS IMAGERY SHOWS ADDITIONAL/HIGH-BASED CONVECTION OVER NERN WY...BUT A GEN DECREASE IN DEPTH/COVERAGE OF THAT CONVECTION DURING PAST HOUR AS DIABATIC HEATING WEAKENS. IF THIS TREND CONTINUES AS EXPECTED...AND DRY ADVECTION CONTINUES OUT OF GCC-AREA DOWNSLOPE REGIME WH

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR SVR STORMS CONTINUES ACROSS WW 448...AND MAY EXTEND NWD INTO PARTS OF CNTRL IND.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN ORGANIZING LINE OF STRONG TO SVR STORMS FROM JUST SOUTH OF TERRE HAUTE IND TO NORTH OF LOUISVILLE KY WILL POSE A THREAT FOR SVR WINDS/HAIL AS ENEWD/EWD PROPAGATION OCCURS OWING TO MODEST ENELY/ELY INFLOW OF EXTREMELY UNSTABLE AIR. THIS WILL SUPPORT A CONTINUED SVR THREAT ACROSS NWRN PARTS OF THE WW AREA DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. THIS WILL ALSO SUPPORT A SVR THREAT INTO PARTS OF CNTRL IND. HOWEVER...WITH INCREASING INHIBITION OWING TO NOCTURNAL COOLING...AND GIVEN THE JUXTAPOSITION OF THE ANTICIPATED CONVECTION WITH ONLY MODEST MID-LEVEL FLOW...THE GENERALLY BRIEF SVR THREAT WILL BE ISOLATED. THUS...A NEW WW IS NOT WARRANTED ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL IND. ADDITIONAL STORMS DEVELOPING NEAR AND JUST BEHIND AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY EXTENDING EAST OF THE LOUISVILLE AREA WILL POSE A SVR THREAT AS THEY APPROACH CNTRL KY DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS AMIDST STRONG INSTABILITY. ..COHEN.. 07/02/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SOME COUNTIES ARE BEING REMOVED FROM WW 451 OVER WRN MT PER COORD W/WFO MSO...AND ADDITIONAL WRN PORTIONS WW MAY BE CLEARED AS CONVECTIVE/STABILIZATION TRENDS WARRANT. OTHERWISE...SVR POTENTIAL WILL CONTINUE ALONG/AHEAD OF SECONDARY COLD FRONT MOVING EWD ACROSS W-CENTRAL MT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AS OF 01Z...SECONDARY FRONT WAS ANALYZED FROM HILL COUNTY SWWD ACROSS JEFFERSON/BEAVERHEAD COUNTIES...AND SHOULD CONTINUE MOVING EWD...PRECEDED IN MANY AREAS BY TSTM CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES. BESIDES ONGOING TSTMS FROM LWT AREA SWD...ADDITIONAL CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE ALONG FRONT AND OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES. CONVECTION CONTINUES TO DEVELOP AND MOVE NEWD OUT OF PERSISTENT GENESIS REGION OVER HIGHER TERRAIN OF SWRN MT/E-CENTRAL ID...ALONG/AHEAD OF WRN COLD FRONT. NARROW CORRIDOR OF RELATIVELY STG MLCINH IS INDICATED BY MODIFIED RAOBS AND MODEL SOUNDINGS ACROSS CENTRAL MT BETWEEN FRONTS...BUT WAS NOT SAMPLED WELL BY BRACKETING RAOBS AT GGW AND MSO. MLCINH MAY INCREASE AREA-WIDE DURING NEXT FEW HOURS AS SFC TEMPS COOL...HOWEVER SUFFICIENT MOISTURE...INSTABILITY AND SUBCLOUD DRYING ABOVE SFC WILL PERSIST TO MAINTAIN SVR GUST THREAT IN ADDITION TO LARGE HAIL. MLCAPE 500-1500 J/KG SHOULD REMAIN IN PRECONVECTIVE BOUNDARY LAYER OVER MUCH OF WW AREA...THROUGH AT LEAST 03Z...AMIDST 45-60 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES THAT WILL SUPPORT CONTINUED SVR THREAT. ..EDWARDS.. 07/02/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SVR THREAT MAY PERSIST FOR ANOTHER COUPLE OF HOURS AS A SQUALL LINE MOVES SWD ACROSS PARTS OF SRN GA AND INTO NRN FL. THIS ACTIVITY WILL LIKELY HAVE EXITED MOST OF THE REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF WW 445 BY OR SHORTLY AFTER THE SCHEDULED 02Z EXPIRATION TIME...WITH ISOLATED CONVECTION TO THE NORTH EXPECTED TO WEAKEN.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A W-E-ORIENTED SQUALL LINE ACROSS SRN GA WILL CONTINUE TO PROPAGATE SWD OWING TO ASCENT AT THE LEADING EDGE OF THE COLD POOL AMIDST EXTREME INSTABILITY. THIS INSTABILITY WAS SAMPLED BY THE JACKSONVILLE 00Z RAOB THAT FEATURED AN MLCAPE VALUE OF 4945 J/KG. HOWEVER...WITH OUTFLOW BEGINNING TO SURGE AHEAD OF THE LINE -- PER MOODY AIR FORCE BASE 0.5-DEGREE REFLECTIVITY DATA -- OWING TO WEAK DEEP SHEAR...IT WILL EXHIBIT INCREASINGLY ANAFRONTAL CHARACTERISTICS DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. AND...WITH NOCTURNAL STABILIZATION CONTRIBUTING TO INCREASING CINH...THE SVR THREAT WILL BECOME INCREASINGLY SPARSE THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS. THUS...ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE IS NOT NEEDED. STORMS FARTHER NORTH IN SC MAY POSE AN ISOLATED MARGINAL SVR THREAT DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS...THOUGH THIS THREAT WILL DECREASE AS THEY ENCOUNTER INHIBITION OWING TO EARLIER CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING AND GROWTH OF THE NOCTURNAL BOUNDARY LAYER. ..COHEN.. 07/02/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS/LINE SEGMENTS WILL POSE A THREAT FOR SVR WIND GUSTS/HAIL ACROSS REMAINING VALID PARTS OF WW/S 446/448/452.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MODERATE INSTABILITY IN ADVANCE OF STORM CLUSTERS/OUTFLOW FROM WRN WV TO CNTRL KY WILL MAINTAIN A THREAT FOR SVR WIND/HAIL WHILE STORMS APPROACH THE APPALACHIANS. A WELL-DEFINED BOWING SEGMENT ARCS FROM LOGAN COUNTY WV TO PIKE COUNTY KY TO BREATHITT COUNTY KY...AND WILL POSE THE MOST SUBSTANTIAL THREAT FOR SVR WINDS IN THE SHORT TERM AS IT MOVES ACROSS SRN WV...SERN KY...AND INTO WRN VA. ADDITIONAL CLUSTERS OF STORMS TO THE WEST TOWARD CNTRL KY AREA WILL ALSO POSE A MORE ISOLATED SVR WIND THREAT...WITH A PEAK WIND OF 52 KT MEASURED AT LEXINGTON AIRPORT AT 0144Z. AREAS SOUTH OF THESE STORMS MAY WARRANT LOCAL AREAL EXPANSION OF WW/S INTO CNTRL KY...THOUGH A NEW WW IS NOT NEEDED OWING TO THE ANTICIPATED ISOLATED/SHORT-TERM THREAT. FARTHER NE INTO NRN WV...RELATIVELY WEAKER INSTABILITY MAY CONTINUE TO SUPPRESS STORM INTENSITY/LONGEVITY...THOUGH AN ISOLATED SVR THREAT MAY PERSIST INTO WRN MD GIVEN RELATIVELY STRONGER DEEP SHEAR IN THAT VICINITY. AREAS IN THE WAKE OF ONGOING CONVECTION/OUTFLOW MAY BE CLEARED FROM REMAINING VALID PARTS OF THE WW/S. ..COHEN.. 07/02/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: OUTFLOW-DOMINANT MCS WITH RADIALLY FORWARD-PROPAGATIONAL TENDENCIES WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE/SPREAD OVER DISCUSSION AREA THROUGH ABOUT 06Z. BEFORE THIS COMPLEX SUBSTANTIALLY WEAKENS...ISOLATED SVR GUSTS...AS WELL AS GUSTS NEAR SVR LIMITS BUT STILL CAPABLE OF OCNL DAMAGE...MAY PERSIST. HOWEVER...GIVEN TRENDS DISCUSSED IN MORE DETAIL BELOW...WW IS NOT PLANNED ATTM.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: FOREGOING AIR MASS CONTAINS SUFFICIENTLY HIGH THETAE TO SUPPORT SOME POTENTIAL FOR ADDITIONAL CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ALONG AND SHORTLY BEHIND LEADING GUST FRONT...IN TURN REINFORCING ALREADY ROBUST COLD POOL. WEAK SWLY SFC WINDS SOMEWHAT AUGMENT ALREADY FAVORABLE STORM-RELATIVE INFLOW...FURTHER SUPPORTING POTENTIAL FOR ACTIVITY TO PERSIST TO GULF COAST. 925/850 MB DEW POINTS ON SOME UPPER AIR CHARTS ARE OVERDONE DUE TO UNREASONABLY MOIST...SATURATED TO SUPERSATURATED...NEARLY ADIABATIC LAYER IN 00Z TAE RAOB. NONETHELESS...MODIFICATION TO THAT PROFILE ALONG WITH JAX RAOB...MODEL FCST SOUNDINGS AND GPS DATA STILL SUGGEST 1.75-2 INCH PW OVER THIS REGION...ATOP OBSERVED MID-70S F SFC DEW POINTS. THIS SUPPORTS 2000-3000 J/KG MLCAPE. RELATED RELATIVE MIN IN MLCINH WILL SUPPORT CONTINUED POTENTIAL FOR INTENSE OUTFLOW WINDS AT SFC FOR ANOTHER COUPLE HOURS. HOWEVER..WITH TIME...TWO FACTORS SHOULD REDUCE SVR RISK... 1. GRADUAL DIABATIC SFC COOLING OF PRECONVECTIVE AIR MASS...AND 2. SPREAD OF OUTFLOW FARTHER AWAY FROM MOST OF ITS PARENT CONVECTION...LEADING TO SHALLOWER/WEAKER ASCENT ATOP COLD POOL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: BEST-ORGANIZED WIND-DAMAGE POTENTIAL WILL CONTINUE TO BE WITH MCS MOVING SEWD ACROSS SPINE OF APPALACHIANS IN SWRN VA...EXTREME NERN TN AND INTO ADJOINING NWRN NC. SOME UNCERTAINTY EXISTS AS TO HOW FAR SE THIS ACTIVITY CAN MAINTAIN SVR GUST THREAT...GIVEN ITS WELL-DEVELOPED COLD POOL AND ISALLOBARIC PERTURBATIONS COUNTERACTED BY INCREASINGLY STABLE AIR THAT IT WILL ENCOUNTER. OVERALL ENVIRONMENTAL INDICATIONS ARE THAT GEN WEAKENING TREND SHOULD OCCUR NEAR AND SE OF EXISTING WW EDGE...LOCAL/TEMPORARY FLUCTUATIONS ASIDE. WITH SVR POTENTIAL EXTENDING BEYOND SRN PORTIONS OF CURRENT WW AREA...HOWEVER...ADDITIONAL/SMALL WW MAY BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MOST SFC OBSERVATIONS OVER WHICH THIS COMPLEX HAS PASSED DURING PAST COUPLE HOURS SAMPLED SUB-SVR GUSTS...HOWEVER BKW AND PSK MEASURED 51 AND 56 KT GUSTS WITHIN PAST HOUR. GUST FRONT APPEARS TO BE STAYING SEVERAL MILES AHEAD OF PARENT REFLECTIVITY CORES OVER SWRN VA AND ADJOINING NC BORDER. COMPLEX WILL BE MOVING INTO AIR MASS CHARACTERIZED BY PROGRESSIVELY STRONGER MLCINH AND WEAKER MLCAPE...BOTH WITH SEWD EXTENT AND WITH TIME...RELATED TO 1. OUTFLOW AIR FROM EARLIER/WELL-ORGANIZED MCS ACTIVITY...AND 2. DIABATIC SFC COOLING THROUGHOUT AREA...AFFECTING BASE OF RELATIVELY DRY SUBCLOUD LAYER SAMPLED BY 00Z GSO RAOB. MODIFIED RAOBS AND FCST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST DRY AIR ABOVE COOLING SKIN-LAYER WILL AID IN DOWNDRAFT ACCELERATION...ESPECIALLY NW OF DAN-GSO-AVL LINE. DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL REMAIN WEAK...SO ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE TO BE DOMINATED BY FORWARD-PROPAGATIONAL INFLUENCES UNTIL GUST FRONT NO LONGER IS STG/STEEP ENOUGH TO FORCE CONVECTIVE LIFT OF WEAKLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS. FARTHER NE...AIR MASS JUST ABOVE SFC OVER CENTRAL/NRN VA IS MORE MOIST/UNSTABLE THAN FARTHER S...BUT ALSO WILL EXPERIENCE WEAKER LIFT ALONG LEADING EDGE OF ITS PORTION OF CONVECTIVE PLUME. SVR THREAT OVER THIS AREA IS NONZERO BUT MORE CONDITIONAL...AND LIKEWISE SHOULD DIMINISH WITH TIME DUE TO GRADUAL DIABATIC SFC COOLING/STABILIZATION. ..EDWARDS.. 07/02/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALLY EXTENDED PORTION OF SEVERE TSTM WATCH 449 CONTINUES UNTIL 07Z ACROSS NORTHEAST MT...WITH DAMAGING WINDS/SOME SEVERE HAIL REMAINING POSSIBLE. SOME SEVERE THREAT COULD DEVELOP INTO PORTIONS OF NORTHWEST ND OVERNIGHT...SUCH THAT A WATCH MIGHT BE POSSIBLE.

WHILE UNCERTAIN...THIS SCENARIO CANNOT BE RULED OUT GIVEN ISENTROPIC ASCENT FOCUSED TO THE NORTH OF A WARM FRONT THAT EXTENDS WNW-ESE ACROSS THE REGION.
